messages:
morgan: Deploying console v2.3.1 to prod tonight 21:00 PT (UTC-7). Plan: canary 10% -> 50% over 2h, then full at 22:00 if smoke is green. I'll kick off CDN invalidation after canary passes. Who can own smoke and purge?

ashley: I can own smoke testing 21:10-21:40 PT. Which user journeys are highest priority?

morgan: Top priorities: landing page, login, /dashboard, workspace load, quick search, and the embeddings debug panel. Look for JS errors, SSR regressions, asset 404s, and obvious performance regressions.

morgan: Quick smoke script to run locally or from staging box:
```
# basic smoke curl checks
curl -I https://console.example.com/ 
curl -I https://console.example.com/dashboard 
curl -sS https://console.example.com/_health | jq 
```
(also click through login + a few workspace actions)

raj: For CDN: we'll invalidate /static/* and /assets/* after canary. Note: CloudFront invalidation usually propagates ~5-10m; if you need instant swaps use a cache-bust header for the main bundle. Edge TTL currently 300s.

nicole: Pre-warmed the main bundle via the edge-prime job at 20:30 PT, and pushed hashed filenames. Also set Cache-Control: public, max-age=60 for index.html during rollout so we can flip faster.

azh (typo fixed): tagging zach instead of azh

zach: @oncall-frontend please watch logs and real-user metrics for 30m after full rollout. I'll monitor Sentry and LB 5xxs.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: 10% -> initiated at 21:00:18 PT. Canary tag: canary-v2.3.1

ashley: Smoke update @21:13 PT: landing/login ok, dashboard loads but a couple of console warnings about missing optional props; search suggestions slightly slower (~200ms). No 5xxs so far.

morgan: Good. Keep an eye on search latency; if p50 > 500ms we pause canary. Also check the embeddings panel — it calls a new endpoint.

ashley: embeddings panel ok, sample query returns expected results. No errors in the client logs.

raj: CDN purge ready. I'll issue invalidation after we hit 50% canary and smoke stays green. Command I will run: 
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id ABCD1234 --paths "/static/*" "/assets/*"
```

deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 50% completed at 21:22:04 PT. No automated rollbacks triggered.

ashley: Final smoke @21:25 PT: everything looks nominal, small CSS flicker on first load but not blocking. No new Sentry errors.

morgan: Proceed with CDN invalidation and schedule full rollout for 22:00 PT. Rollback plan: tag v2.3.0 is available, and rollback command is `deployctl promote --to v2.3.0 --service console`. Keep me posted within the next 30m if anything spikes.

raj: Invalidation sent at 21:26 PT. Expect edge to pick up changes by ~21:35-21:40 PT.

deploy-bot: Full rollout scheduled for 22:00 PT unless manual abort.

zach: I'll monitor metrics during the 22:00 push. Paging list: @oncall-frontend, @infra-oncall.

ashley: Thanks — I'll stay on for 30m post-rollout to run quick exploratory checks.

morgan: Awesome — thanks everyone. Leaving checklist: smoke ✅, invalidation ✅, rollback ready ✅. Will post final status after full rollout. :thumbsup:
